business.description: ISF Limited is an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) listed on BSE, engaged in providing financial solutions to individuals, entrepreneurs, and MSMEs with focus on niche lending segments such as electric vehicle financing, battery financing, small business funding with emphasis on women microentrepreneurs, invoice discounting, and supply chain finance.

products.name: Micro-credit for Women Microentrepreneurs
products.note: Short-tenor credit based on business potential rather than collateral

products.name: Loans
products.note: Loan balances towards various categories of loans given by the Company

brands_or_certifications: Base Layer NBFC under Scale-Based Regulation

outlook.statement: The NBFC sector is expected to sustain growth in the mid-teens (around 13-17%) in FY 2026-27, supported by continued retail credit demand, digital penetration and diversified funding channels. Profitability will be shaped by funding costs, credit-quality management and regulatory compliance, and by external headwinds from the West Asia conflict. The Company will focus on prudent portfolio expansion, technology-led efficiencies and robust risk management, prioritising the quality of the book over the pace of growth.
Conduct periodic evaluations of pandemic and geopolitical risks, Business Continuity Plan, and liquidity management
Strengthen the leadership position to steer the company's growth in chosen business segments
Concentrate efforts on digital initiatives to efficiently cater to customers and educate them on the digital payment of EMIs
Uphold customer loyalty through cultivating strong relationships and ensuring customer satisfaction
Employ data analytics in loan disbursement and recovery procedures
Enhance the loan portfolio's quality and diversify funding channels, including capital-market and co-lending arrangements

risks: Inadequate availability of bank finance and increase in borrowing costs
Competition from captive finance companies, small finance banks, and FinTechs
External risks associated with liquidity stress, geopolitical and political uncertainties, and fiscal-slippage concerns
Early-delinquency stress in small-ticket personal loans and microfinance segment
impairment loss allowance based on expected credit loss (ECL) on loans
uncertainty over ultimate realisability of loans
The Company has incurred cash losses in the current financial year as well as in the immediately preceding financial year.
